---
name: Draft feedback
about: A question, counterexample, or wording proposal for CBEE
---

## Revision and section

Identify the published revision or working-source commit and the relevant section.

## Claim or wording to examine

Explain the ambiguity, question, or proposed change.

## Evidence boundary and example

Describe what the evidence establishes and any additional assumption needed.
Public references or a small counterexample are welcome.

Please keep private correspondence and sensitive evidence out of this issue.
A question is enough; no patch or implementation is required.
See CONTRIBUTING.md and ISSUE-PROCESS.md for contribution guidance and review.
Email feedback is equally welcome.
